failure_summary.description: Added an unnecessary category word or overly specific event name instead of returning the concise answer at the requested granularity.
Answered a setting named in the clue rather than the play whose identity the clue asks for.

patch.reasoning: The existing exact-granularity rules cover unnecessary category wording and over-specific answers, while the clue and evidence checks already require inferring the answer slot and not substituting a nearby entity. These failures reflect nonapplication of existing guidance, so no edit is warranted.
